evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive issued in the present to erase knowledge — an irrealis command targeting abstract categories (fleet, contracts) rather than a concrete event.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Present-tense imperative to eliminate knowledge of a general category (routes), irrealis in its commanded-yet-unrealized erasure.
